user_story: As a user, I want to update the priority of an existing task so that I can reprioritize my work.

positive.title: Update task priority successfully
steps: Navigate to the task management page.
Change the priority level from 'Medium' to 'High'.
positive.expected_result: The task priority is updated to 'High' and is reflected in the task list.

negative.title: Attempt to update task priority without selecting a task
steps: Navigate to the task management page.
Attempt to change the priority without selecting a task.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating a task must be selected before updating the priority.

edge.title: Update task priority to the same level
steps: Navigate to the task management page.
Change the priority level from 'Medium' to 'Medium'.
edge.expected_result: The system displays a message indicating that no changes were made as the selected priority is the same as the current one.
